episode_title: Air Travel Ground Stop, Starship Rocket Launch, ExxonMobil Eyes Return to Venezuela
script_en: Air Travel Ground Stop, Starship Rocket Launch, ExxonMobil Eyes Return to Venezuela.
Federal officials say telecommunication outages were to blame for the nationwide ground stop that paralyzed air travel on Friday, but offered few details about what caused the issues.
SpaceX conducted a major test of its Starship rocket Friday night.
American oil giant ExxonMobil eyes a return to Venezuela as President Trump continues to promise historic oil deals in the South American nation.
